items.title: Strategy to Leave MSCI Indexes By Month End, Metaplanet Also Out
items.summary: Strategy and Metaplanet, both flagged by MSCI’s non-operating company screen, drop out of its indexes at the Nov. 30 close, and Strategy is the only one of 24 USA Index deletions not moving down to small cap.

items.title: MSCI Drops Michael Saylor’s Strategy (MSTR): Is Bitcoin Price at Risk?
items.summary: Index provider MSCI said on Wednesday, November 11, that it will remove Strategy (MSTR) from its global stock indexes. Strategy is the largest corporate holder of Bitcoin, and the change takes effect after the market close on November 30. Funds that track those indexes will have to sell their shares. ...

items.title: Strategy, the World’s Biggest Corporate Bitcoin Holder, to Be Dropped From MSCI Indexes
items.summary: Strategy stock dropped premarket after MSCI ruled the company ineligible for its global indexes.

items.title: Indonesian rupiah hits record low amid MSCI downgrade concerns
items.summary: Investing.com-- The Indonesian rupiah dropped to a record low on Thursday as the dollar strengthened and concerns grew over potential exclusion from MSCI Inc. emerging-market indexes.

items.title: Why MSCI Removed MSTR From Its Indexes – And What It Means For Bitcoin Stocks
items.summary: One annual screening for companies on the watchlist has already failed. If they fail the next one, they may be removed, and crypto treasury firms not included in the indexes cannot be added while failing either of their last two screens.
